description: A scanned sequencer of 4 steps: a phase signal sweeps across the steps, and each step interpolates along a curve between two anchor voltages

params.text: Sets how many of the steps the sweep runs across
Sets the range of every anchor LEVEL knob: 0-10V at UNI, or -5 to 5V at BI
Sets the curvature of that step's curve; centred is a straight line, clockwise pushes the steep part towards the end and counter-clockwise towards the start, and the extremes are nearly square
Sets how much of the sweep that step takes up against the other steps, 0 to 200%; at 0 the step is skipped, and with every step at 0 the sequence stops
Sets the voltage of that step's phase 0 anchor while LEVEL is the anchor's chosen source, within the range set by the UNI/BI switch
Chooses how that step's phase 0 anchor reads its source: SMPL takes one reading when the step becomes active and holds it, TRACK follows the source for as long as the step is active
Chooses where that step's phase 0 anchor takes its voltage: its own LEVEL knob, the A, B or C input, or the OUT jack
Sets the voltage of that step's phase 1 anchor while LEVEL is the anchor's chosen source, within the range set by the UNI/BI switch
Chooses how that step's phase 1 anchor reads its source: SMPL takes one reading when the step becomes active and holds it, TRACK follows the source for as long as the step is active
Chooses where that step's phase 1 anchor takes its voltage: its own LEVEL knob, the A, B or C input, or the OUT jack
Chooses the shape of that step's curve: a J curve that steepens at one end, or an S curve that steepens through the middle

inputs.text: A signal that any step's anchor can sample or track
The phase signal that drives the sweep: 0-10V maps to a phase of 0 to 1, and voltages outside that range wrap round into it
Modulates that step's curvature; every 1V here turns the CURVE knob a tenth of its travel clockwise
Modulates that step's share of the sweep; every 1V here turns the phase width knob a tenth of its travel clockwise
Modulates that step's phase 0 level; every 1V here turns the LEVEL knob a tenth of its travel clockwise
Modulates that step's phase 1 level; every 1V here turns the LEVEL knob a tenth of its travel clockwise

outputs.text: Carries the voltage generated by the active step
Carries the number of the active step, 10V divided by the module's step count for each step, and 0V while every step's phase width is 0
Carries the phase of the active step, rising from 0V at the start of the step to 10V at its end

notes: the light above each step shows the phase of that step while it is active, running from red at phase 0 to green at phase 1
the sweep is driven entirely by the voltage at the phase input, the jack printed with a Greek phi; with nothing patched there the module holds step 1 at the start of its curve
the module is mono: it reads the first channel of a polyphonic cable and ignores the rest, and every output carries a single channel
